definitions: An annual Hindu festival originating in the Indian subcontinent which reveres and pays homage to the Hindu goddess Durga.
A ten-day festival, of which the last five days are the most significant, celebrating the victory of Durga over the buffalo demon Mahishasura.
examples: Durga Puja is a major festival in West Bengal.
Many Bengalis living in the UK celebrate Durga Puja with great enthusiasm.
